column1: # TF-conformation pilot registry — the single source of truth for every pilot.
# This replaces hand-written config/pilots/<tf>.sh files. Those are now GENERATED:
#     python scripts/pipeline/gen_pilot_configs.py            # regenerate all
#     python scripts/pipeline/gen_pilot_configs.py --check     # CI: fail if stale
# Do not edit config/pilots/*.sh by hand; edit this file and regenerate.
# WHY THIS EXISTS. The TBP pilot shipped for months with NDT80's motif because
# PWM_LABEL was typed by hand and never cross-checked against
# config/deeppbs_pdb_pwms.csv (docs/tbp_label_error_downstream.md). Here the
# label is DERIVED from the master table keyed on pdb_id, and the optional
# pwm_label pin below is itself verified against that same table. Either way a
# motif belonging to a different protein is rejected, so the error class is
# blocked by construction rather than caught by review.
# Columns
#   tf_name            pilot name; names config/pilots/<tf_name>.sh and all outputs
#   pdb_id             source structure (must NOT be in data/folds/id.txt — leakage)
#   binding_chain      source-chain FILENAME letter: <pdb>_chain<X>_protein.pdb
#   protein_chain      0-based mdtraj chainid of the protein in <pdb>.cif
#   dna_chains         0-based mdtraj chainids of the two DNA strands
#   n_frames           frames in the BioEmu xtc (drives the Stage 3 array size)
#   test_pwm_filter    regex selecting this pilot's eval subset from id.txt
#   test_filter_name   human label for that subset; say "(family transfer)" if it is one
#   on_target_usable   yes | no — "no" blocks any on-target statistic downstream
#   on_target_n        expected match count; the validator fails on drift. blank = unchecked
#   pwm_label          OPTIONAL pin. Leave BLANK to derive from the master table
#                      (preferred). Set it only when the structure has several
#                      valid motifs and the choice is historical. A pin is still
#                      VERIFIED against the master table, so a label belonging to
#                      another protein is rejected either way — pinning chooses
#                      among that structure's own motifs, it does not bypass the
#                      check. Four pilots are pinned because 1lo1/1k79/1vtn/5d5u
#                      each carry both a HOCOMOCO and a JASPAR label and the
#                      original runs used JASPAR; switching now would change
#                      Y_pwm and invalidate their results.
#   notes              free text, carried into the generated config as a comment
# Derived automatically, so NOT columns here:
#   PWM_LABEL                  <- config/deeppbs_pdb_pwms.csv, keyed on pdb_id
#   FOLD, RAMP_STAGES, STEPS_PER_STAGE, RECOVERY_*  <- lib/common.sh defaults
#                                 (identical across all 12 pilots; see git log)
#   the _dnarelax variant       <- ARM=dnarelax env var, not a second file
# Verify chain layout before adding a row:
#   python stage2_redock/stage2_redock.py --ref structures/source_chains/<PDB>_chains/<PDB>.cif --inspect-only
tf_name
csl
column12: RBPJ/CSL. True monomer: Notch/MAML assemble off the DNA-reading module. 3brg chosen over 3iag because 3iag is itself an id.txt test entry.

column1: egr1
column12: C2H2 zinc finger. Structural Zn requires the Stage 3 metal cage.

column1: engrailed
column12: Homeodomain. Own motif absent from id.txt, so NO on-target subset. A 10-entry Homeodomain family-transfer subset exists (DUX4|MEIS2|CDX2) if opted into deliberately.

column1: err
column12: Filter spans much of the nuclear-receptor superfamily (RXRA, GCR, NR5A, ESRR) across 7 PDBs. This is superfamily transfer, not on-target.

column1: ets1
column12: ETS. Largest positive own-family effect in the study, but it does not survive FDR across pilots (q=0.14).

column1: foxa
column12: Filter corrected 2026-10-15: the old MA1683|FOXA matched 0 entries. The 5 Forkhead anchors are all FOXO1 across only 2 PDBs (6lbi x4, 3coa x1).

column1: hsf
column12: n=3 across only 2 PDBs (7dcj x2 chains, 5hdn x1).

column1: lef1
column12: HMG-box. The ONLY HMG-box in the benchmark, so no on-target AND no family fallback. General-130 only.

column1: ndt80
column12: Created to replace the mislabelled TBP pilot. 2euv IS NDT80, so structure, label and the 5 anchors finally agree. 2euv is in no fold, so augmenting cannot double-count a baseline entry.

column1: nfat
column12: WARNING: 13 of the 15 matched entries are NF-kB (TF65/RelA, NFKB1, NFKB2), not NFAT. Family transfer at best; do not report as on-target.

column1: runx
column12: Runt. Note the unusual chain layout: protein on 0, DNA on 1,2.

column1: tbp
column12: Label corrected 2026-10-15 from NDT80's MA0343.1 to TBP_HUMAN. No usable on-target test: n=1, and that entry (7oh9_K) is a histone chain. All pre-2026-10-15 tbp artifacts are invalid; see docs/tbp_label_error_downstream.md.
